entries.zh: 认清自己的本分；安分守己
entries.en: to know oneself; to know one's own station and duty
entries.notes: 西语栏末词 mendando se 拼写存疑（疑为 mirando se 之讹），不影响四栏互证。

entries.zh: 心神；指精神状态、心思
entries.en: mind; mental state, spirits
entries.notes: 西语栏 'conocer para con, saberla' 残乱不成句，释义依汉字栏与闽、官两栏对音。

entries.zh: 相识；彼此认识、有交情
entries.en: to know one another; to be acquainted

entries.zh: 面熟；面善眼熟、见过面而认得
entries.en: to know each other by sight; familiar of face
entries.notes: M 栏较 R/H 多 'hoe bin' 两音节（疑为'會面'），核心义不受影响。

entries.zh: 〔原件残缺，释义存疑〕指知（他人）的缺点、毛病
entries.en: to perceive (someone's) faults; to note shortcomings (uncertain)
entries.notes: 汉字栏首字[疑:掠/扐]，M 栏 'lia pype' 残乱且与 R 栏三音节不合，仅据西语栏 conocer las faltas 与'病'之毛病义定释义。

entries.zh: 看破（某人的）心思；识破其心肠
entries.en: to see through (someone's) heart; to know him for a great rogue
entries.notes: 汉字第三字[疑:爾/凍]（R 音 ni 近'爾'），西语栏句子残乱，取'看破心肠'之义。

entries.zh: 识认；认得、辨认
entries.en: to know; to recognize (a person or thing)

entries.zh: 识得心腹；深知内心、摸清意图
entries.en: to know (someone's) inner heart; to know his intentions

entries.zh: 会面；见面
entries.en: to meet; to see one another

entries.zh: 认错；承认自己有错，亦指弄错、认错人
entries.en: to admit one's mistake; to confess an error; also to mistake (one person/thing for another)

entries.zh: 所见短；见识短浅、所知有限
entries.en: to have little knowledge; of narrow insight

entries.zh: 〔原件残缺，释义存疑〕相识已久；阅知甚多
entries.en: long acquainted, much known (reading uncertain)
entries.notes: 汉字栏两处[疑]且 M（bat y cu）与 R（chy i gien）对音不合，姑据西语栏 conocido mucha(=mucho) 与 M 栏音节作'相识已久'。

entries.zh: 历事；经历过的事情、阅历
entries.en: things one has gone through; experience of affairs

entries.zh: 熟事；熟谙事务、办事老练
entries.en: well acquainted with affairs; experienced, practiced

entries.zh: 名声大；有名望
entries.en: well known; of great renown
entries.notes: '影大'搭配罕见，据西语栏 conocido mucho 与 17c 语境解作'名声大'，义有推断。

entries.zh: 出色；出众、有名而体面
entries.en: outstanding, distinguished; known and honored

entries.zh: 征；出征讨伐、征服一国
entries.en: to conquer (a kingdom); to campaign against, subdue

entries.zh: 伐；征伐、攻打他国
entries.en: to attack (a state); to wage war on, conquer

entries.zh: 打国度；攻打国家、夺取国土
entries.en: to conquer a kingdom; to take a country by force

entries.zh: 出征；出兵打仗、远征讨伐
entries.en: to set out on a campaign; to march against (a kingdom)

entries.zh: 征伐；兴师征讨、攻伐他国
entries.en: to conquer by war; to campaign against and subdue
